IoT Monitoring Platform

Reusable sensor-to-cloud data collection and monitoring system

A reusable sensor-to-cloud platform that connects physical devices to real-time dashboards — supporting multiple protocols, device types, and alert configurations.

Problem: Organizations have deployed sensors and devices with no easy way to collect, visualize, or act on the data they generate.

Features: Multi-protocol support (MQTT, Modbus, HTTP), Real-time dashboards, Alert and threshold engine, Historical data storage, Device management, API access.

Target users: Energy companies, utilities, facilities teams, industrial operators, smart building managers.

Who is IoT Monitoring Platform for? Energy companies, utilities, facilities teams, industrial operators, smart building managers

What problem does this product solve? Organizations have deployed sensors and devices with no easy way to collect, visualize, or act on the data they generate.

Can AICORE customise this product? Yes. AICORE can adapt product workflows, integrations, dashboards, user roles, and deployment details around your organisation's requirements.
